one_to_one.description: Single test step maps to single automation script line
one_to_one.enforcement: Each test step must have exactly one corresponding script line
one_to_one.validation: Verify step count equals script line count

one_to_many.description: Single test step maps to multiple automation script lines
one_to_many.enforcement: Must split into sub-steps (e.g., 1a, 1b) with each mapped to one script line in sequence
one_to_many.validation: All sub-steps must be executed in order, no skipping allowed
one_to_many.split_step_naming: Use parent step number + lowercase letter (1a, 1b, 1c)
one_to_many.execution_order: Sequential execution required, order field must increment

intermediary_step_requirements.order_enforcement: Order field must be sequential and unique across all intermediary steps

step_breakdown_rules.no_merging_policy: Each distinct action must have its own intermediary step, no combining allowed

purpose_supporting_steps.definition: Implicit steps required for test execution, validation, or evidence collection

types.setup_steps: Initialize test environment, navigate to starting point
types.validation_steps: Assert expected state, verify no errors, check element presence/absence
types.supporting_steps: Screenshot capture, logging, data collection for test evidence

identification_criteria: Steps not explicitly in test case but required for automation
Verification and assertion steps for test validation
purpose_supporting_steps.mandatory_inclusion: All purpose/supporting steps must be included in intermediary_steps array with appropriate flags

completeness_check.no_omissions: Every test step must have corresponding automation script lines
completeness_check.all_scripts_mapped: Every automation script line must be mapped to a test step or intermediary step
completeness_check.intermediary_coverage: All intermediary steps must reference a parent test step

execution_order_validation.sequential_order: Order field must increment sequentially without gaps
execution_order_validation.parent_child_order: Child steps (1a, 1b) must follow parent step order
execution_order_validation.no_parallel_execution: All steps execute in strict sequence

explicit_mapping_validation.clear_relationship: Each mapping must explicitly state test step to script line relationship
explicit_mapping_validation.split_steps_documented: For one-to-many, all split steps must be listed

reusability_framework.template_structure: This rule set serves as template for all test case automation
reusability_framework.adaptable_patterns: Mapping rules apply to any test case with similar step structures
reusability_framework.consistent_naming: Use consistent naming conventions for split steps across all test cases
reusability_framework.version_control: Track rule version for updates and improvements

strict_enforcement_policy.no_exceptions: All rules must be followed without exception
strict_enforcement_policy.validation_required: Automated validation of rule compliance before script execution
strict_enforcement_policy.audit_trail: Maintain record of all mappings and intermediary steps for compliance
strict_enforcement_policy.failure_handling: Script execution fails if any rule is violated
